p.title: No single freshness record: screens, gates and the watchdog each judged age from their own clock, and some screen data had no refresh path at all
p.symptom: Owner question 2026-11-04: is every card on every screen refreshed automatically? Audit found: structural-data-research.json (08-21) and factor-backtest-longrun.json (07-10, no age bound) read by screens with no writer in any workflow; kr-investor-flows.json empty since 10-20 because the BOK_API_KEY secret is absent; scenario-state.json 7 of 8 and today-verdict.json 8 of 8 recent commits differed only in generatedAt (212 KB every 30 minutes); a lane that failed and kept its previous file looked identical to one that confirmed it.
p.root_cause: Freshness lived in three places with different clocks: the lineage audit POLICIES (artifact timestamp), the watchdog (data/screener/telegram only), and each screen's own reading of generatedAt. No record said which workflow refreshes an artifact, when a run last confirmed it, or which session it reflects, so 'unchanged' and 'not refreshed' could not be told apart and a timestamp-only rewrite was the only way to look fresh.
p.fix: src/data/contracts/artifact-freshness.js registers every runtime-read artifact (34 automatic: workflow, producer, cadence, stale bound, clock and basis paths; 7 hand-kept with their expiry gate). refresh-data and refresh-screener write public-data/freshness/<workflow>.json (aio-freshness.v1: producedAt, checkedAt, basisSession, expectedEveryMinutes, staleAfterMinutes, lastAttempt) before their gates; a timestamp-only rewrite of a derived artifact keeps the published bytes. The lineage audit counts a ledger confirmation of the exact content; the watchdog grades every ledger row (stale = error, late/blocked = warning) with the same freshnessState the browser reader src/data/freshness.js uses (root._aioArtifactFreshness). factor-backtest-longrun gets a 120-day lineage bound.
p.violated_rule: Owner 2026-11-04: every screen value refreshes itself or says it does not; one freshness source
p.prevention: {R}: scripts/ci-artifact-refresh-path-check.mjs fails when a public-data file a runtime reader names has no registry entry, when a registered workflow does not stage it or its producer is missing, when the registry stale bound differs from the lineage bound, or when a ledger workflow writes its ledger after recording the candidate; an exhaustive fixture pins the ledger verdict for written x skipUnchanged x same-content and the reader/watchdog grading. On HEAD it fails (no registry; factor-backtest-longrun had no bound).
p.verification: node scripts/ci-artifact-refresh-path-check.mjs OK (39 runtime-read names). Local run of write-freshness-ledger: 8 derived artifacts recognised as timestamp-only and kept; git status clean. Watchdog against live Pages: both ledgers reported as not yet published (warning) until the first v59.70 refresh.

r.title: Every screen artifact has a registered refresh path and one freshness record
r.rule: A public-data artifact a runtime reader names is registered in src/data/contracts/artifact-freshness.js: automatic (workflow stages it, producer exists, stale bound equals the lineage audit) or hand-kept (named expiry gate). Producing workflows write public-data/freshness/<workflow>.json before their validation gates; badges read src/data/freshness.js and the watchdog grades the same rows.

qa.text: v59.70: after the first refresh, public-data/freshness/refresh-data.json and refresh-screener.json are live, the watchdog's freshness-<workflow> checks pass, and timestamp-only scenario-state/today-verdict rewrites are no longer committed

changelog: **One freshness record for every screen (v59.70, {P}/{R}):** each producing workflow now writes when it last confirmed each artifact and which trading day it reflects; the watchdog and the screens read that one record, timestamp-only rewrites are no longer committed, and a gate fails when any data a screen reads has no refresh path.
